description: Modulation transfer function (conventions: Modulation transfer function; ADR 0176).

cases.source: h = 0.999^n, 3000 samples at 1 kHz: the closed form at the STI octave-centre modulations
h = 0.9^n, 60 samples at 100 Hz: F = 0 gives 1, F = fs/2 the alternating sum
F = 5 at fs 4 aliases to F = 1: sqrt(2)/2
|h|^2 = 25, 25: the same as the hand pair
impulse_response must not be all zero
case hand times 2^1000: squares of the samples overflow a double, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case hand times 2^-1000: squares of the samples underflow to 0, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case complex times 2^1000: squares of the samples overflow a double, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case complex times 2^-1000: squares of the samples underflow to 0, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
